invariants.rationale: Method always returns a new instance; only throws on unsupported table types.
metaClient is a required non-null parameter and used without null-check.
config is passed to constructed HoodieJavaTable subtypes and used without null-check.
context is passed to constructed HoodieJavaTable subtypes and used without null-check.
Return value is always of type HoodieJavaTable or its subtype.
